name: A Refugee's Quandary
summary: Gnomeregan's displaced gnomes flee into Dun Morogh after troggs and radiation drive them from their home. Near Anvilmar, engineer Felix Whindlebolt has lost his tools and belongings to Frostmane scavengers.

sections.title: The Flight from Gnomeregan
sections.body: Troggs overran Gnomeregan, the high-tech city beneath the earth. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and his advisors released radioactive gas to kill the invaders. The gas brought disaster instead. Thousands of innocents died, survivors became mindless leper gnomes, and the rest fled across Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Scavengers in the Snow
sections.body: Gnome engineers and tinkerers carried away the tools and blueprints they could save. Frostmane trolls prowl the icy mountain passes between Gnomeregan and Coldridge Valley. As Felix Whindlebolt hurried toward shelter at Anvilmar, Frostmane raiders took his tool chest, lockbox, and bucket of bolts. They carried his belongings to camps southwest of town.

faq.answer: Felix Whindlebolt is a gnome engineer who escaped Gnomeregan's radioactive destruction. He shelters near Anvilmar and cannot fight off Dun Morogh's dangers, so he tries to recover his stolen equipment.

Gnome authorities released radioactive gas during a trogg invasion, hoping to wipe out the invaders. Instead, the gas contaminated Gnomeregan's ventilation systems. It killed or mutated most residents and made the city uninhabitable.
Frostmane trolls took Felix's chest, box, and bucket of bolts. They ambush travelers on Dun Morogh's mountain trails, then carry stolen scrap and gear to their encampments southwest of Anvilmar.

faq.q: Where did the displaced gnomes seek refuge?
faq.answer: Many displaced gnomes fled across Dun Morogh to Ironforge. Others found temporary shelter in settlements such as Anvilmar and Kharanos.

faq.q: Why does a bucket of bolts matter so much?
faq.answer: For an exiled gnome tinkerer, tools, specialized screws, and machined bolts are a livelihood. Without proper equipment, refugee engineers cannot ply their trade, fashion defenses, or rebuild their lives in exile.

faq.q: What threat do the Frostmane trolls pose to Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: The Frostmane tribe has long lived in Dun Morogh's harsh peaks. With trogg outbreaks and Gnomeregan's evacuation bringing chaos, the trolls have grown bolder. They raid supply lines and ambush travelers.

angles.text: As a gnome, you know the bitter tragedy of losing your wondrous home to poison and betrayal. Now everyday tinkerers must ask strangers to recover basic tools from the trolls.
As a dwarf, you know the Coldridge mountains have sheltered your kin for centuries. Helping gnome refugees secure a foothold in Anvilmar honors the ancient alliance between Ironforge and Gnomeregan.
As an engineer, you know a craftsman cannot stand by while scavengers take precision bolts, calipers, and toolboxes assembled over a lifetime.
